description: Defines classes and structures for managing UE (User Equipment) events within a cellular scheduler, including event handling, queuing, and interaction with other scheduler components.

classes.name: ue_cell_event_manager
classes.description: Manages UE events for a specific cell, including event queuing, processing, and handling various UE-related indications and requests.

classes.name: ue_event_manager
classes.description: Facilitates management of UE events across multiple cells, acting as a facade for subcomponents and ensuring thread-safe operations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates cell event processing and clears pending events.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Processes pending events when a slot indication is received.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles confirmation that UE configuration has been applied.

methods.name: handle_ue_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles requests to deactivate a UE.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles downlink MAC control element indications.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indications for past slots.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to manage UE events.
